evidence.mission_note: A 2023 ND2 manual squarely fits the enthusiast-bridge brief: reliable, fun on Highway 1, and easy to resell in 6-24 months. Its asking price sits above the ideal band but under the ceiling.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity: the VIN decodes cleanly to a 2023 MX-5 Sport soft top with a 2.0L, the 6-speed manual is stated, and the dealer reports a single owner with no reported accidents. The asking price of $23,941 sits at the low edge of the mileage-adjusted fair band, though most comps are higher Club/GT trims. Nothing is observed wrong, but no photos, service records, tire dates or title status were captured, so condition is unproven. A known airbag-module software recall (24V695000) covers this model range, and its completion on this VIN is not shown. Time-based items such as the first brake fluid flush are likely due at three years. The dealer's stated openness to a buyer's-mechanic inspection, in California, makes these open questions straightforward to answer before money moves.
evidence.next_action: Ask Karplus Warehouse for the full history report, the recall-completion printout, service receipts, tire DOT dates and an itemised out-the-door price, then book an independent PPI in the San Fernando Valley.
